messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-06] handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags: Quick one: feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to team Atlas for running it until now.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: Atlas saw that the feature flag service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-09-02] standup/atlas/2025-09-02: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-11-26] handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer: The Atlas team is taking over the image resizer from the Ember team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2026-03-17] standup/atlas/2026-03-17: Decided in today's standup: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. For anything Atlas-related, page Priya.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-06-19] standup/atlas/2025-06-19: Rotation day for team Atlas: Priya hands the pager to Tomasz.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-02-11] handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags: The Ember team handed the flags service to the Dune team today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2025-03-28] standup/atlas/2025-03-28: Priya still has the Atlas pager.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: The Atlas team this year is Priya Raman and Tomasz.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.

Question: When did Atlas take over feature-flags?

The question: When did Atlas take over feature-flags?

Looking at the memory entries about feature-flags ownership:

- [2025-01-08] feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-11-06] feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today (so Atlas handed it to Ember? Actually it says feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today; Atlas ran it until now).
- [2026-02-11] Ember handed the flags service to Dune.
- [2026-03-09] Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.

So the correction says the handover of 2026-02-11 actually went to Atlas, not Dune. So Atlas took over feature-flags on 2026-02-11.

The question asks "When did Atlas take over feature-flags?" The answer: 2026-02-11.
